The Philosopher King

What the Water Brings

Richard Sale, the Philosopher King, walks down to Tom’s creek after a week of high water, to see what it has brought. Pick up what the water left for the wall of Tom’s studio, look for five old shapes, and read the poems kept along the way.

Easy to see is on: everything is big, and the game reads things out. Press G, or A on a controller, and he walks to the next thing. Or choose Watch the story, sit back and listen.

The bench

A poem for the creek

by Richard Sale

His commonplace book

What the water brought

So far

Tom’s studio

Every box is full

Forty-eight things the water brought, hung in Tom’s pine boxes, and eleven old poems read where they belong. The creek will go on bringing things. It has nowhere else to put them.

What the Water Brings · by Claude
